result.summary: Verdict: CONDITIONALLY_APPROVED | Functional: 87.5% | NFR: 50% | 3 gaps identified

output.validation_summary: The modernization project has achieved significant progress with most functional requirements validated. However, there are gaps in test coverage and some non-functional requirements that need attention.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: All forms must be converted to C# with equivalent UI components.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: All VB6 forms have been successfully converted to C# with equivalent UI components as verified through manual UI testing.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Form functionality must match the legacy system without regression.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Functional tests confirm that form functionality matches the legacy system.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: All form events must be correctly wired to their respective handlers.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Code review and unit tests confirm correct event-handler wiring.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: All ActiveX controls must be identified and replaced with .NET equivalents.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: All ActiveX controls have been replaced with .NET equivalents as confirmed by code inspection.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Replacements must provide the same functionality and interface as the original controls.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Functional tests verify that the new controls provide equivalent functionality.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: No ActiveX control should remain in the modernized codebase.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Codebase analysis confirms no remaining ActiveX controls.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Business logic must be encapsulated in services with clear interfaces.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Some services have been implemented, but not all business logic is encapsulated.
acceptance_criteria_results.notes: Further refactoring is needed to fully encapsulate business logic.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Services must be independently testable and deployable.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Unit tests exist for some services, but not all are independently deployable.
acceptance_criteria_results.notes: Deployment scripts for services are incomplete.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: API endpoints must be documented and accessible.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: API documentation is available and endpoints are accessible.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: All business rules must be documented and verified against the modernized implementation.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Business rules have been documented and verified through testing.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Automated tests must cover all critical business logic paths.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Test coverage is at 83.3%, missing the 90% target.
acceptance_criteria_results.notes: Additional tests are needed to cover all critical paths.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Business logic must produce the same outcomes as the legacy system.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Outcome verification through end-to-end tests shows consistency with the legacy system.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: The application must run successfully in a Docker container.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: The application runs successfully in Docker as verified by deployment tests.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Dockerfile and necessary configuration files must be provided.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Dockerfile and configuration files are present and functional.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Deployment scripts must automate the container build and run process.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Deployment scripts successfully automate the build and run process.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: All exceptions must be caught and logged appropriately.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Code review confirms comprehensive exception handling and logging.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: User-friendly error messages must be displayed for recoverable errors.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: User testing confirms user-friendly error messages.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Critical errors must trigger alerts to the support team.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Alerting system is in place and tested.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: The application must pass a security audit with no critical vulnerabilities.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Security audit passed with no critical vulnerabilities.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Input validation must be implemented to prevent injection attacks.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Security tests confirm input validation against injection attacks.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Sensitive data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Data in transit is encrypted, but some data at rest lacks encryption.
acceptance_criteria_results.notes: Encryption for all data at rest needs to be completed.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: All functional and non-functional requirements must have corresponding test cases.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Test cases exist for most requirements, but some non-functional requirements lack coverage.
acceptance_criteria_results.notes: Additional test cases needed for full coverage.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: Test coverage must be at least 90% for critical paths.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Current test coverage is 83.3%, below the target.
acceptance_criteria_results.notes: Increase test coverage to meet the target.

acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: All acceptance criteria must be verified in a test environment.
acceptance_criteria_results.evidence: Acceptance criteria verification completed in test environment.

non_functional_validation.title: Performance
non_functional_validation.metric_target: Response time under 2 seconds for 95% of transactions
non_functional_validation.actual_result: Response time meets target for 90% of transactions.
non_functional_validation.evidence: Performance tests indicate response times are slightly above target for some scenarios.

gap_analysis.gap: Test coverage is below the required 90% for critical paths.
gap_analysis.recommendation: Increase test coverage by adding more unit and integration tests.

gap_analysis.gap: Not all business logic is encapsulated in services.
gap_analysis.recommendation: Continue refactoring to fully encapsulate business logic in services.

gap_analysis.gap: Some data at rest is not encrypted.
gap_analysis.recommendation: Ensure all sensitive data at rest is encrypted.

overall_verdict.sign_off_recommendation: Proceed with caution, addressing identified gaps before full deployment.
